        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "from scipy.signal import savgol_filter\n",
        "from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "# CONFIGURACIÓN\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "PREPROCESS_MODE = \"sg67\"\n",
        "# Opciones:\n",
        "# \"raw\"\n",
        "# \"sg31\"\n",
        "# \"sg67\"\n",
        "# \"sg101\"\n",
        "\n",
        "N_COMPONENTS = 2\n",
        "TOP_LOADINGS_TO_LABEL = 10\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "# CARGA DE DATOS\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "data_train = pd.read_excel(\"data_train.xlsx\")\n",
        "data_test  = pd.read_excel(\"data_test.xlsx\")\n",
        "\n",
        "data = pd.concat([data_train, data_test], axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "y = data.iloc[:, 0].astype(float).to_numpy()\n",
        "X = data.iloc[:, 1:].astype(float).to_numpy()\n",
        "\n",

        "# ============================================\n",

        "print(\"Primeras longitudes:\", wavelengths[:10])\n",
        "\n"
      ]

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# ============================================\n",
        "# TRANSFORMADORES\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "class SavitzkyGolay(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, window_length=31, polyorder=2, deriv=1, delta=2.14):\n",
        "        self.window_length = window_length\n",
        "        self.polyorder = polyorder\n",
        "        self.deriv = deriv\n",
        "        self.delta = delta\n",
        "\n",
        "    def fit(self, X, y=None):\n",
        "        return self\n",
        "\n",
        "    def transform(self, X):\n",
        "        X = np.asarray(X, dtype=float)\n",
        "        n_points = X.shape[1]\n",
        "        wl = int(self.window_length)\n",
        "\n",
        "        if wl % 2 == 0:\n",
        "            wl += 1\n",
        "        if wl > n_points:\n",
        "            wl = n_points if n_points % 2 == 1 else n_points - 1\n",
        "        if self.polyorder >= wl:\n",
        "            raise ValueError(\"polyorder debe ser menor que window_length\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        return savgol_filter(\n",
        "            X,\n",
        "            window_length=wl,\n",
        "            polyorder=self.polyorder,\n",
        "            deriv=self.deriv,\n",
        "            delta=self.delta,\n",
        "            axis=1\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {

      "source": [
        "# ============================================\n",
        "# FUNCIÓN DE PREPROCESAMIENTO\n",
        "# ============================================\n",
        "def preprocess_data(X, mode=\"raw\"):\n",
        "    Xp = np.asarray(X, dtype=float).copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    if mode == \"raw\":\n",
        "        return Xp\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif mode == \"sg31\":\n",
        "        return SavitzkyGolay(window_length=31, polyorder=2, deriv=1, delta=2.14).transform(Xp)\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif mode == \"sg67\":\n",
        "        return SavitzkyGolay(window_length=67, polyorder=2, deriv=1, delta=2.14).transform(Xp)\n",
        "\n",
        "    elif mode == \"sg101\":\n",
        "        Xp = SavitzkyGolay(window_length=101, polyorder=2, deriv=1, delta=2.14).transform(Xp)\n",
        "\n",
        "        return Xp\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        raise ValueError(\"Modo no reconocido\")"
      ],
